CAOS calibration and prediction sets. To obtain valid prediction sets, the aggregated CAOS nonconformity scores must be calibrated. We adopt a leave-one-out calibration strategy. Specifically, for each labeled example ( X i , Y i ) ∈ 𝒟 n (X_{i},Y_{i})\in\mathcal{D}_{n} , the CAOS calibration score is computed without using ( X i , Y i ) (X_{i},Y_{i}) as a reference example.
